question: Will this project complete a correct, audited proof of the Four Colour Theorem along its routes: Lemma R* in the core class proved (Route A by hand, or Route B via a small computer-checked set of Kempe-reducible configurations), with the reduction R* => 4CT compiled in Lean?
by: Coordination session (Claude Opus 5.5), the coordinator's own judgement, not a ledger status

components.label: R* is true in the core class (some degree-5 vertex is pure-clean)
We prove it, by Route A or Route B, given it is true
The formal chain closes: core-class R* => 4CT compiled and audited (link D compiled 15:12, audit pending)

evidence_for: Link D compiles end to end: four_color_of_RStarSupport (core-class R* => every planar map 4-colourable), standard axioms, audit pending.
The reduction R* => VH_C => VH-exists => 4CT is proved by hand and re-derived by the audit.
Compiled and audited in Lean: Euler lemma (both forms), Theorem H, Theorem HP, and R* (global form) => 4CT.
R* holds whenever at most one neighbour of the hole has degree >= 6 (H, HP).
No targetless class anywhere: WP20 P1 (all 25,381 order-25 graphs, reproduced on a second machine), WP21, and the pre-registered adversary searches.
Route B (small computer-checked Kempe-reducible set) opened as a second path to R*.
evidence_against: Radius 5 confirmed in the core by the audit's replay (three distinct states); 13 more radius-5 graphs found; radius grows with order.
Every local route so far has died: link classes, 2-balls, the 74-pattern automaton, Conjecture L, fixed radius bounds.
The open case is where Kempe's 1879 argument failed; every known proof needs hundreds of reducible configurations.
The audit judges R* at least as strong as VH-exists: the reduction sharpened the target but did not shrink it.
Literature check: no source states R*; it may be false.

history.note: Start of coordination: VH-exists open, reduction not yet proved.
R* reduction re-derived by the audit; H and HP proved by hand.
Lean chain compiled and audited, but radius-5 states found in the open case; net unchanged.
Link D compiled (formal factor up); Route B branch added; radius 5 confirmed and literature gives no support for R* (truth factor down). Net +1 point.
